answer_1.quote: In the main experiments, we show the relative speedup. Here we report the raw metrics given our computational environment. We evaluate inference with Hugging Face transformers using Flash Attention 2, and applying Flex Attention. To further evaluate the effectiveness of DBSA, we include results on two additional datasets: MMLU and SAMSum. MMLU is a widely used benchmark for multitask multiple-choice question answering that covers a broad range of subjects. In addition to classification datasets, we also evaluate on SAMSum, a generative task on dialogue summarization.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate DBSA on 5 language classification datasets—TREC, TREC-fine, NLU, Banking-77, and Clinc-150... For further evaluation, we also include results on MMLU (a multitask QA benchmark) and SAMSum (a generative summarization task) in Appendix B.
